purpose: Verify authoritative digital recording of visitor registration
preconditions: Visitor not previously registered
action_or_input: Register new visitor with full name, phone, email, and ID document details
expected_result: Visitor record is created with SHA-256 hashed identity and unique visitor ID

purpose: Verify role-based permission enforcement for role assignment operations
preconditions: User authenticated without Super Admin privileges
action_or_input: Attempt to grant VMS operational roles or permissions
expected_result: Action is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify public module contract integration for active visitor lookup
preconditions: Active visit exists for host user ID
action_or_input: Invoke get_active_visitors_by_user_ids public contract getter
expected_result: Returns mapping of user ID to list of active visitor records

purpose: Verify immutable audit logging of gate check-in events
preconditions: Approved visit pass exists for visitor
action_or_input: Security guard scans QR code to check in visitor at Main Gate
expected_result: GateLog record created with timestamp, actor_id, gate_name, reader_machine_id, and check_in event type

purpose: Verify pass validity period constraints enforced at registration
preconditions: Host user exists
action_or_input: Submit visit request with valid_to earlier than valid_from
expected_result: Request refused with validation error

purpose: Verify blacklist addition and subsequent lookup restriction
preconditions: Security Admin authenticated
action_or_input: Add individual with Government ID and phone to blacklist registry
expected_result: BlacklistEntry record is created with active status and hashed ID

purpose: Verify blacklist match prevention during visit registration
preconditions: Active blacklist entry exists for visitor ID hash
action_or_input: Submit visit registration for matching visitor ID
expected_result: Registration is rejected and critical GateAlert is created

purpose: Verify host notification and listing of actionable pending visit requests
preconditions: Visit request submitted targeting host user ID
action_or_input: Host requests list of pending approvals
expected_result: Pending visit request is returned with status requested

purpose: Verify host approval transitions visit to approved state and generates pass
preconditions: Visit request in requested state for host
action_or_input: Host executes approve action
expected_result: Visit status transitions to approved and unique pass_number and qr_code_hash are generated

purpose: Verify host rejection transitions visit to rejected state with reason
preconditions: Visit request in requested state for host
action_or_input: Host executes reject action with rejection reason
expected_result: Visit status transitions to rejected and rejection_reason is recorded

purpose: Verify visit status update upon gate check-in
preconditions: Visit in approved state with valid pass
action_or_input: Security guard scans pass at gate terminal
expected_result: Visit status updates to checked_in and check_in_time is recorded

purpose: Verify gate check-in refusal when pass is expired
preconditions: Visit in approved state with valid_to in the past
action_or_input: Security guard attempts scan check-in
expected_result: Check-in refused with PassExpiredError and visit state remains unchanged

purpose: Verify gate alert generation when blacklisted visitor attempts entry
preconditions: Visitor pass created prior to visitor being added to blacklist
action_or_input: Security guard scans QR code at gate
expected_result: Entry is denied and GateAlert of type blacklist_gate_entry_attempt is logged

purpose: Verify gate check-out transitions visit to checked_out and records exit time
preconditions: Visit in checked_in state
action_or_input: Security guard processes check-out with visit ID
expected_result: Visit status updates to checked_out and check_out_time is recorded

purpose: Verify walk-in registration by security personnel with default validity
preconditions: Security guard authenticated with vms.gate.scan permission
action_or_input: Register walk-in visitor with host ID and purpose
expected_result: Visit created directly with pass duration defaulting to 4 hours

purpose: Verify on-site visitor active count selector accuracy
preconditions: Two visits checked_in and one visit checked_out
action_or_input: Query active on-site visitor count
expected_result: Count returns exactly 2

purpose: Verify emergency muster initiation records headcount and triggers alert
preconditions: Three visitors currently checked_in
action_or_input: Security Admin triggers emergency muster roll-call
expected_result: EmergencyMuster record created with headcount_total=3 and critical GateAlert created

purpose: Verify quick visitor search by phone or name
preconditions: Visitor registered in system
action_or_input: Execute search query with visitor phone number
expected_result: Returns matching visitor profile

purpose: Verify offline gate scan batch reconciliation
preconditions: Approved visit pass exists in database
action_or_input: Submit batch sync payload containing offline check-in record
expected_result: Event reconciled into GateLog and visit status transitioned to checked_in

purpose: Verify zone access validation against pass allowed_zones
preconditions: Visit pass active with allowed_zones=['Admin Block']
action_or_input: Verify zone access for 'Server Room'
expected_result: Access is denied with unauthorized zone response
